    DAMPISTCOEFFICIENT, RESTORINGCOEFF, DRIVINGLENGTHCOEFF, PARAMETER_INITIAL_LOCATION, PARAMETER_VELOCITY_INITIAL_LOCATION = params
    
    # Calculate the moving distance due to damping
    moving_distance = params[2] * (x - PARAMETER_VELOCITY_INITIAL_LOCATION * v)
